race.comment: SKYDREAM (4) found a good track to her liking when scooting along in front to score an easy maiden win here just over 2 weeks ago. She had been to the fore at the jump-outs, so that win has been a long time coming. Now that the penny has dropped, she can repeat the dose here, despite the 3.5kg weight rise. HUSTLE (1) improved sharply from her fresh-up run to finish a half a length from the winner in fourth place at Wodonga 4 weeks ago. She has been placed in her only run on this course, and with luck off a tricky gate, she will be hard to hold out. PACIFIC JEWEL (8) is a lightly tried 6YO mare resuming from a spell, and she looked in forward condition when placing at a recent jump-out. The bandages are off, which has to be a good sign, and she could bob up at a price in this. NO OVERTAKING (5) is racing her way back into some good form, so stick with her.
